name: goose-skills
title_zh: 给 Claude Code 装上增长团队，广告投放
tagline_zh: 不用再开五个 SaaS 来回切。广告、社媒、内容、线索、SEO、数据抓取，六路增长动作直接在你终端里跑。
tagline_en: Stop tab-hopping across five SaaS tools. Run ads, social, content, lead gen, SEO, and scraping straight from your.
desc_en: Library of Growth & GTM skills + data APIs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor to run ads, social, content, lead gen, seo and data scraping
why_zh: 不是零散 prompt，是带数据 API 的成套技能库。别人给你话术，它给你能落地的投放和抓取管线。
why_en: Not scattered prompts—a skill library wired to data APIs. Others give you talk; this gives you runnable ad and scraping.
limit_zh: 只覆盖增长与 GTM 场景，不含代码审查或运维。需自备 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor 环境。
limit_en: Growth & GTM only—no code review or ops. Requires Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor plus your own API keys. Scraping subject to target-site terms; IP.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A growth team for Claude Code: ads, SEO, scraping, lead gen
